meta.name: feature-factory
meta.description: This skill should be used when taking a single software feature from intent to shipped as a solo developer — goal-first, TDD, deterministic verification, evidence only where it earns its keep, and human judgment at the two moments that matter (goal approval, merge). Trigger when the user says "let's build feature X", "ship this feature", "run this through the factory", "write a goal contract", "feature-factory", or wants a disciplined intent→merge loop that resists process bloat. NOT for whole-product planning, multi-feature roadmaps, or autonomous multi-agent swarms.
